description: Search verified venues (read-only). Filter by text, city, kind (a topic such as restaurants, cafes, bakeries, markets, street-food, or a group: eat, drink, bake, do), cuisine, dietary, price tier, opening time, or near a coordinate. Results are ranked by relevance then editorial score and carry provenance (source URL, checked_on, open_status), hours, a page URL to cite and a tracked booking link where one exists. Returns at most `limit` items; an unknown city returns {did_you_mean: [...]} instead of a list.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. 'new-york-city' or 'New York City'. Unknown cities answer with did_you_mean.
city.title: City

country.description: Country slug or name, e.g. 'italy'. Optional where city is given.
country.title: Country

cuisine.description: Cuisine slug or name, e.g. 'sichuan', 'neapolitan pizza'.
cuisine.title: Cuisine

kind.description: A topic slug (restaurants, cafes, bakeries, markets, street-food...) or a group: eat, drink, bake, do.
kind.title: Kind

near.description: 'lat,lng' to search around a point; results then sort by distance.
near.title: Near

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.
offset.title: Offset

open_at.description: 'now', a weekday and time such as 'sunday 10:00', or an ISO datetime (UTC). Venues with unparseable hours are returned last, flagged.
open_at.title: Open At

price_tier.description: The site's tier symbols for the country, e.g. '€€' or '$$$'.
price_tier.title: Price Tier

query.description: Free text: a venue name, dish, cuisine, neighbourhood or theme.
query.title: Query

name: search_places
title: Search verified places
